title: Water Release: Glue Technique
body:
Syntax: perform water release: glue technique <item>

Description: Requires Water chakra nature, a Pot of Glue, and a carried item. Consumes the pot and glues the item to you so it cannot be dropped or traded. Requires Water chakra nature. Ninjutsu unlocks at level 35. Costs 35 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
